chapters.chapter_name: Overview to Engineering Graphics: Drawing instruments and
content: accessories, utilize drawing instruments and materials
effectively. Follow and apply standard practice as per B.I.S. for
planning and outline, select appropriate scale factor for the
drawing as per given condition; Write remarks on a drawing
where ever necessary. select suitable line & dimensioning style
for a given geometrical object; improved the skill to draw
polygons, circles and lines with different geometric situations:
Use of plane scales and R. F.

chapters.chapter_name: Engineering Curves: Types & application of Engineering 08
content: Curves, Construction of Conics, Cycloidal Curves, and
Involutes & Spirals the length of with normal and tangent to
each curvature.

chapters.chapter_name: Projections of Points and Lines: Introduction: Principal Planes 07
content: of Projections, Projections of the points positioned in same
quadrant and different quadrants, Projections of line with
inclination to one reference plane and with two reference planes,
True length and its inclination with the reference planes.

chapters.chapter_name: Projections of Planes: Projections of planes: - polygons, circle 07
content: and ellipse with its inclination to one orientation plane and with
two reference plane; idea of auxiliary plane method for
projections of the plane.

chapters.chapter_name: Orthographic Projections: Fundamental of projection with 06
content: classification; Principal planes of projection, Projections from
the graphic view of the entity on the principal planes for
observation from front, top & sides by means of first angle and
third angle projection technique, full sectional view.

chapters.chapter_name: Isometric Projections and Isometric View or Drawing
content: Isometric Scale, transformation (redefine) of orthographic views
into isometric projection, isometric view or drawing.
Note: Topic No. 1 & 6 of the above mentioned syllabus to be covered in Practical
Hours.
